eligibility_evidence: Position: Systems and Network Engineer Work Mode: On site   Location: Lahore Timings: 8pm to 5am - Rotating Shift We are a Managed Services Provider (MSP) delivering enterprise IT services to international clients.
We are looking for a System Engineer – Level 2 with strong experience in Microsoft 365, Windows Server environments, and hybrid cloud infrastructure.
This role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, the ability to manage complex hybrid infrastructures, and experience working in a multi-client MSP environment.
Cloud & Hybrid Environment Management  -Support hybrid environments integrating on-premises infrastructure with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in on-premises and cloud environments, along with experience in technical leadership and mentoring junior engineers. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE -3–8 years of experience in system administration and Microsoft infrastructure management. -Hands-on experience with Windows Server (2008–2022). -Hands-on experience with VMware virtualization environments. TECHNICAL EXPERTISE Candidates should have hands-on experience with:  -Microsoft 365 Administration  -Exchange Online migrations (Cutover, Staged, Hybrid)  -Azure Active Directory / Entra ID  -Azure AD Connect / Directory Synchronization  -VMware ESXi and vCenter  -Windows Server administration  -Group Policy management  -Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager  -Conditional Access and identity security  -Backup solutions (Veeam or equivalent)  -Cloud-to-cloud backup solutions  -Patch management
